name: hotel-rate-comparator
description: Hotel rate comparator powered by Temporal workflows

scripts.dev: concurrently -n suppliers,api,worker,web -c magenta,cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:suppliers" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.stack: concurrently -n stack,web -c cyan,green "npm run -w backend dev:stack" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run -w backend build && npm run -w frontend build
scripts.lint: npm run -w backend typecheck && npm run -w frontend typecheck
